description.text: There are A, B, C three levels of scholarship for you to apply according to your overall evaluation. Click the small picture to view the full-sized picture. How much do I have to pay to get my Scholarship? For the service fee, generally speaking, SICAS will only charge you 10% of the 4 or 3 years of total scholarship amount (there could be a bit difference according to the exact Type of Scholarship that you choose). However, in the beginning , only $300 to $400 need to be paid as a minimum service fee and $75 as application fee to the university at first. When SICAS help you successfully get the scholarship,then the price difference need to be paid. For example: If you get the Undergraduate C Level of Shandong Jiaotong University, The total cost will be: RMB 9000x 4years x 10% =RMB 3600 = USD 600. and since you have paid USD 400, then the price difference: USD 600 - USD 400 = USD 200 need to be paid. Scholarship Guaranteed ? Yes. -After you paid the Scholarship Service Fee as above table listed, SICAS will guarantee you the scholarship! It is true. -Refund or not ? 100% refund if SICAS failed to get the scholarship (Application Fee +Service Fee) for you! Refund Policy Declaration from SICAS board as following sealed and singed. Objectives The PhD program of Computer Science and Technology provides students with both the theoretical and the latest technological knowledge. The program has a practical orientation and aims to equip researchers and engineers with knowledge in modern experimental methods and skills that allow them to meet the complexities of today’s challenges in the field of Computer Science and Technology. Candidates are expected to be able to engage in scientific research, and to assume leadership role in the IT industries. Duration Duration of program is between 3-4 years with course works in the first year, followed by a dissertation project. Research Areas 1. Computer Application Techniques 2. Pattern Recognition and Intelligent System 3. Computer Software Theory 4. Information Security Credit Units Students need to successfully complete minimum 14 credits including 4 credits of core courses, 4-6 credits of elective courses, and 4 credits of practical courses. Inquiry to email: scholarship@sicas.cn

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5833 USD/per year ￥ 42000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. Study Plan in Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus)

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 2. Be Healthy. 3. Have attained a Master's diploma with good marks. 4. Have solid financial support to afford the study and living expense in China. 5. Good English reading, writing and speaking skills.
